name: Outrigger Waikiki Beach Resort
insider_take: Prime beachfront paradise where Hawaiian culture meets modern luxury right on world-famous Waikiki Beach.
whats_special: This iconic resort sits directly on Waikiki Beach with zero barriers between you and the Pacific Ocean. Home to Duke's Waikiki, named after legendary surfer Duke Kahanamoku, the hotel features live Hawaiian music nightly and hosts the annual Duke's OceanFest. The property boasts one of the few beachfront pools in Waikiki and offers complimentary cultural activities including lei making and hula lessons.
pro_tip: Book an oceanfront room on floors 10+ for unobstructed Diamond Head views, and time your arrival for Duke's famous Barefoot Bar sunset happy hour with live music.
dont_miss: The hotel's prime location puts you steps from the Waikiki Beach Walk entertainment district and just minutes from Diamond Head crater hiking trail. Catch world-class surfing competitions right outside your window, and explore the nearby International Market Place for shopping and dining. The resort's beach services include complimentary snorkel gear and beach chairs.
pros: Prime beachfront location directly on world-famous Waikiki Beach
Authentic Hawaiian cultural experiences and entertainment programs
Multiple dining options including oceanfront restaurants
Central location within walking distance to shopping and attractions
cons: Busy tourist area with high foot traffic
